Long, flowing, platinum-white hair with straight bangs framing the face. Serene, oval-shaped, pale violet eyes. Apparent age of twenty-four with a mature, ethereal expression. Slender, graceful build. A high-collared, flowing white gown with gold filigree embroidery and a pale gold sash. A delicate gold circlet rests upon the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
